components.name: ALL_EMOJI
components.doc: Flat, order-stable list used for search across categories.

members.name: emoji
members.doc: Chosen emoji with the active skin tone applied where the base takes one.

members.name: base
members.doc: Base sequence without a skin tone modifier.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Called when an emoji is chosen by click, Enter, or Space. Check event.shiftKey to keep a popover open for several picks.

members.name: skinTone
members.doc: Controlled skin tone: 0 is the default yellow, 1 to 5 go light to dark.

members.name: defaultSkinTone
members.doc: Skin tone before anything has been stored.

members.name: onSkinToneChange
members.doc: Called when a tone is chosen in the tone menu.

members.name: storageKey
members.doc: localStorage key for recent emoji and the tone. Pass null to keep them in memory for this page only. Blocked storage falls back to memory automatically.

members.name: recentLimit
members.doc: How many recently used emoji to keep.

members.name: defaultRecent
members.doc: Shown under Popular until something has been picked.

members.name: columns
members.doc: Emoji per row. Defaults to as many 36px cells as fit, at least 6.

members.name: autoFocus
members.doc: Focuses the search field on mount. Popovers and dialogs usually focus it already.

members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the picker group.

types.name: EmojiEntry
types.doc: Compact built-in dataset: one line per emoji, `base|name|keywords…|tonePositions?`. Parsed once per page load and shared by every picker instance. Skin tone positions mark single-cluster emoji (hands, feet, people) that take a tone modifier; ZWJ sequences skip tones.

members.name: base
members.doc: The base sequence without a skin tone modifier; what gets stored as "recent".
